annotation.interpretation_a: The maximum stream ID received from any peer. This would mean that the peer must track the maximum stream ID received from *all* peers.
annotation.interpretation_b: The maximum stream ID received from the *current* peer. This would mean that the peer only needs to track the maximum stream ID received from the peer it is currently communicating with.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'the greatest maximum stream ID' is ambiguous. It is unclear if this refers to the highest stream ID received from *any* peer, or only the highest stream ID received from the peer initiating the stream. This affects how the peer must track stream IDs and could lead to different implementations.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether 'the greatest maximum stream ID' refers to the highest value received from any peer, or only the highest value received from the peer initiating the stream.
